messages:
Maya: Quick ask 1 private setup preflight UX detail: can we introduce a 'quickfix strip' that surfaces 3 highest-impact issues with a one-line fix and a chevron to expand logs? On mobile, the strip should support swipe-to-expand. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW_MOBILE_EXAMPLE

Devon: Love the strip. For mobile swipe, prefer a tap target for discoverability; swipe is nice but can conflict with native gestures. Maybe support both, tap primary action = expand, swipe secondary = reveal actions.

Alex: Backend constraint: we need structured checks (id, severity, impact_rank, title, quick_fix, raw_log_url, kb_slug). Current probe is text. I'll propose an API patch to add impact_rank and kb_slug.

ops-bot: Probe 2026-05-02T13:22:11Z  results: 26 checks: 3 high, 6 medium, 17 ok. Raw logs: https://internal/preflight/2198765432/log.txt. Fields: stdout, stderr, exit_code.

Keisha: Microcopy draft: header "Fix these to continue setup"; strip item: "Cannot reach registry  Quick fix: allow outbound HTTPS (443)". For mobile, shorten to "Registry unreachable  Fix: allow 443". Provide a short KB link under expand. Avoid 'egress'.

Jamal: Accessibility items: ensure chip text includes status words (Fail/Warn/OK) not only icons; expanded panel must have role=\"region\" and aria-labelledby pointing to a visible heading. For swipe->expand, make sure a visible 'Expand' button exists so keyboard and SR users can open it. Announce preflight completion with aria-live=\"polite\" and include a concise summary.

Maya: UX decision: show the quickcopy icon on the strip that copies the one-line fix; in expanded view show 'Copy full diagnostic'. Keep copy icon tap target at least 44px on mobile.

Devon: Feature-flag both swipe behavior and inline "Why this matters" sentence. We can A/B test whether inline explanations reduce support tickets.

Alex: Timeline: I'll circulate API contract today with new fields. Frontend can implement collapsed-by-default + swipe later behind flag. Keisha + Jamal please review copy and a11y before PR.

Keisha: Will draft compact + mobile microcopy variants and map top error codes to KB slugs by midweek.

Jamal: One more a11y nit: ensure toasts for copy have role=\"status\" and remain visible at least 4s. Avoid auto-dismissing before screen readers can read them.

Maya: Thanks all  I'll update Figma with tap-first mobile affordance, quickcopy placement, and accessible annotations, then ping for review.
